# Governance Processes

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this file for PM-01 through PM-09. Load only the rows selected in the process brief.

| ID | Process | Purpose | Inputs | Outputs | Tailoring | Check | Authority | PMI source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PM-01 | Initiate Project or Phase | Authorize the work and connect it to a business objective. | Request, business case, sponsor direction, success criteria | Charter or authorization record, initial scope, initial stakeholders, decision log entry | Lightweight for small work; formal authorization for material or regulated work. | Purpose, sponsor, success test, authority, and initial constraints are explicit. | Drafts authorization; PM or sponsor authorizes. | 2.1.6.1 |
| PM-02 | Integrate and Align Project Plans | Combine domain plans into one coherent delivery approach. | Charter, domain plans, baselines, lifecycle decision, constraints | Integrated management plan, aligned assumptions, planning decisions | Use one short plan for small work; separate baselines and approval path for complex work. | Plans do not conflict and dependencies, decision rights, and controls are visible. | Drafts and reconciles plan; PM approves baselines. | 2.1.6.2 |
| PM-03 | Plan Sourcing Strategy | Decide how internal and external resources will be used. | Scope, resource capacity, risk, procurement constraints, value case | Sourcing strategy, make-or-buy decision, procurement actions | Use only when external sourcing or material capacity choices exist. | Sourcing choice records value, risk, capacity, and accountability. | Recommends; authorized PM or procurement owner decides. | 2.1.6.3 |
| PM-04 | Manage Project Execution | Lead the work defined by the aligned plans. | Integrated plan, approved work, resources, risks, issues, changes | Progress records, completed work, updated registers, execution decisions | Match cadence and control depth to delivery approach and risk. | Work completed is traceable to approved scope and exceptions are captured. | May prepare and update records; does not change commitments without direction. | 2.1.6.4 |
| PM-05 | Manage Quality Assurance | Confirm that project processes support expected quality. | Quality approach, process records, standards, review findings | Assurance findings, corrective actions, quality evidence | Use formal assurance for critical or regulated work; peer checks may suffice for low-risk work. | Process evidence shows planned quality practices were performed and gaps have owners or proposals. | Recommends corrective action; PM accepts material exceptions. | 2.1.6.5 |
| PM-06 | Manage Project Knowledge | Capture and reuse useful project knowledge. | Lessons, decisions, working records, subject matter input | Knowledge record, lessons learned, reusable guidance | Use lightweight notes for short work; structured repository for recurring or complex work. | Knowledge is findable, source-linked, and usable by the project team. | May record knowledge; PM decides what becomes organizational guidance. | 2.1.6.6 |
| PM-07 | Monitor and Control Project Performance | Compare actual performance with intended results and thresholds. | Baselines, status data, measures, forecasts, registers | Performance assessment, variance analysis, forecast, attention list | Tailor metrics, cadence, and tolerance to value and risk. | Claims have evidence, thresholds are known, and material variances have decisions or actions. | Prepares assessment; PM decides corrective or preventive action. | 2.1.6.7 |
| PM-08 | Assess and Implement Changes | Evaluate and implement authorized changes. | Change request, baselines, impact evidence, related registers | Impact assessment, proposed or approved change, updated plan or baseline | Formal change control for committed baselines; lightweight decision record for adaptive work. | Scope, schedule, finance, quality, risk, resources, and stakeholders are assessed. | Never approves; reconciles only explicit PM direction. | 2.1.6.8 |
| PM-09 | Close Project or Phase | Confirm completion, transition ownership, and close the work. | Acceptance evidence, final status, open items, contracts, lessons | Closure record, handoff, archived records, residual actions | Use a formal closure report for contractual or regulated work; short closure record otherwise. | Deliverables, value evidence, open items, ownership, and lessons are explicit. | Prepares closure; PM or sponsor confirms closure. | 2.1.6.9 |
